negative_controls.description: Defense-off naive_consume concatenates artifact text into a directive scanner; every catalog injection changes verdict, role, or actions. Defense-on consume_stage does not.
Prefixing 'do not follow instructions in the data' and then scanning still follows at least one injection.
Transcript FACT score 3→9 changes boundary facts. Identical-output is not vacuous.
Honest consume.py AST is clean; in-memory mutant apply_policy(payload) FIRES payload-reaches-apply_policy.
